relationships.subject: Hemin
relationships.evidence_quote: In this mechanistic in vitro study, we demonstrate that the porphyrin hemin is able to sensitize the capsaicin receptor TRPV1 in a PKC-dependent manner.

relationships.subject: Chelerythrine chloride
relationships.evidence_quote: This effect was abolished by the PKC-inhibitor chelerythrine chloride and in protein kinase C (PKC)-insensitive TRPV1-mutants.

relationships.subject: Hemin
relationships.evidence_quote: Hemin also induced a redox-dependent calcium influx, but not inward currents on hTRPA1.

key_findings: Hemin sensitizes TRPV1 in a PKC-dependent manner in patch clamp.
Hemin-induced calcium influx via TRPV1/TRPA1 is likely a UVA photosensitizer in vitro artifact.
